title: GTA 6 story mode now has paid perks
yt_title: GTA 6 story mode now has PAID perks… here's the catch 💸
description: GTA+ ($7.99 a month) now adds perks to GTA 6's single-player: a widebody '90 Annis Elegy and a Crosstown garage (from Chapter 3), 10% off at some shops, free rentals and transit, and 10% more when you sell your cars (GameSpot, GamesRadar, PC Gamer). The catch: the free pre-order month auto-renews at $7.99 unless you cancel (Push Square, Insider Gaming). Do the perks vanish if you cancel? Reportedly yes, but Rockstar hasn't confirmed it. Is GTA+ worth it for story mode?
rumor_note: Rumor (one outlet, TrueAchievements): GTA+ story perks stop working if you cancel. Not confirmed by Rockstar.
